evaluation_protocol.note: This evaluation uses validation fold 0 — the fold held out during training. The disease_split_manifest.csv does not include a separate independent test set. Results represent internal cross-validation performance, NOT independent generalization. An independent test set evaluation requires a separate patient-disjoint test split not present in the current dataset preparation.

label_grouping_rationale.Wheezing Disorders: Merges 'Asthma' and 'Bronchitis' because both produce wheezing (CAS) and the dataset does not provide acoustic evidence to distinguish them. Do NOT separate these as asthma vs bronchitis predictions.
label_grouping_rationale.Healthy Control: Maps to 'Control Group' patients in SPRSound summaries.

limitations: Evaluation uses validation fold 0 only (not an independent held-out test set).
Disease labels are patient-level; individual auscultation sites may show acoustic patterns inconsistent with the systemic diagnosis.
Training data is heavily imbalanced (Pneumonia ~77% of records).
Class weights were applied during training but Healthy Control remains very sparse (83 train, 33 val).
Model trained for only 7 epochs; validation loss was increasing, suggesting the model did not fully converge on all classes.
Pediatric population only (0–16.2 years). Do not apply to adult recordings.
Wheezing Disorders merges Asthma and Bronchitis — cannot be separated acoustically from SPRSound labels.
Results are a research screening output and must NOT be used for clinical diagnosis.
